name: GPT Image
tagline: GPT Image is OpenAI's image generation model, available in ChatGPT and through the API as gpt-image-1. Unlike the older DALL-E pipeline, it's built directly on the same transformer architecture as GPT-4o, which gives it much stronger prompt adherence, especially for text rendering inside images and multi-step edits described in plain language. Marketers, product teams, and developers use it to generate assets, mock up designs, and iterate on images conversationally rather than through separate prompt engineering.
